For teachers and tutors

About Test Yourself: Letters and Sounds

An adaptive check of letters and phonics. It draws on Letter Names, Big and Small Letters and all six Sound Gap, Tap Word and Build Word games, from CVC word families up to digraphs and vowel teams.

How to play

  1. Answer each round.
  2. The test changes to match you.
  3. See your results.

Play it as a class

Students take it on their own phones. The results show which phonics games each one should practise next.
